answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in dawn and raven lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the copper graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1237 impostors cost 1390 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
